prelaunch_revision: No target forecasts preceded this revision. Independent review required per-scenario native stepping, complete runtime-input hashes, typed expected failures, explicit timeout dispositions, and resolved-only accuracy. The rejected prelaunch hash snapshot is retained.
purpose: Evaluate frozen original learning procedures on every frozen bottleneck scenario, without tuning or altering prior evidence.
information_contract: Exact supplied physical initial states and held inputs from the frozen reference bank; same retained states and new-unit state in A/B. Only topology and line R/L are supplied to learned compositions. No history estimation, target calibration, checkpoint selection, training or tuning.

training_contracts.cphast: Fixed final staged local 100000-update isolated-DGU fits with fitted linear warm start; original existing learning procedure.
training_contracts.cphnn: Original PHNODE/CompositionalPHNODE; fixed final isolated-component 100000-update checkpoints from local_comparison_1791674863001450000; no augmented objectives.
training_contracts.nphdae: Original DGU_PHNDAE/CompositePHDAE; fixed final 10000-update original_baselines_sensing_20261024 checkpoints. Local samples from 16 three-unit network trajectories, measured line currents converted to local inputs, original l2_and_g_loss. No added constraint-first curriculum. Not the older author_local bank.

comparison_scope: Descriptive comparison of frozen procedures on identical new supplied-state scenarios, not matched training data/budget or architecture-only evidence. Loads extrapolate beyond the prior isolated-component sampling range. This is not the headline voltage benchmark.

solvers.cphast: Maintained native_step and existing network.compose at nominal dt=0.01, two layers, unchanged factory defaults; each scenario is stepped individually to isolate batch-wide convergence. Existing stored clock is approximately 0.009999999036 seconds, disclosed without correction. Record actual stage/coupling settings; observe midpoint residuals without altering operations.
solvers.cphnn: Pinned original CompositionalPHNODE.forward, RK4 dt=0.01; scan is scheduling only.
solvers.nphdae: Pinned CompositePHDAE.solve_one_timestep with T=arange(2001)*0.01, tol=1e-9, consistent_ic=True. Strict upstream fsolve acceptance; no replacement Newton/projection, clipping, fallback or altered Jacobian. Extra unused final RK4 step recorded separately.

initialization: Use each model's own constitutive map. Native/cPHNN reuse saved adapters; N-PHDAE uses the prior frozen bracket policy and training-only domains generalized to n=5,m=4. Retain existing differential storage exactly. Algebraic voltages/currents may be reconciled by the original solver. Save guesses, inversion records, raw steps and fsolve diagnostics.
evaluation: Include t=0. Reference metrics use saved refined 0.001 s paths; errors use refined[::10] at the common 0.01 s grid. Report voltage/DGU-current/line-current RMSE, central-line peak error, current/voltage screening, false accepts/rejects, all pair decisions and failures. Preserve unqualified finite outputs as diagnostics only. No failed prediction is classified as a successful or wrong physical decision.
decision_rule: Among predicted screen-passing attachments choose the one with lower maximum line-current utilization. If neither passes, reject both. If either candidate is numerically unqualified or boundary-unresolved, abstain. Utilization differences <=0.00005 are ties. Report exact feasible-set agreement separately from selected-action acceptability.
failure_policy: All rows predeclared. Retain initialization, strict consistency, constraint drift, nonfinite and budget failures with raw evidence. No accuracy-driven retries or automatic extensions. Unexpected harness failures stop the campaign and are not attributed to a model.
protection: No modifications to website, paper, slides, original models/adapters/checkpoints, reference bank or existing results. New sandbox only. Hash protected files before and after. Independent read-only prelaunch and result verification required.
